title: Document Management | Loan File & Record Retention | Veteran Loan Servicing
description: Loan document management and record retention for commercial portfolios: organized loan files, retained records, and controlled access supporting audit and review.
h1: Loan files organized, retained, and access-controlled
lede: A serviced loan is only as defensible as its file. We keep loan documents organized, retained to meet recordkeeping obligations, and available to the lender.

sections.heading: Process
paragraphs: Loan documents and servicing records are organized against each loan and retained for the period servicing and recordkeeping obligations require. Access is limited to authorized personnel.

sections.heading: Controls
paragraphs: Documents are handled within the United States with encrypted transport, and access is limited to authorized personnel on a need-to-know basis. Every transaction carries an audit-trail entry.

sections.heading: Reporting
paragraphs: On request, we can produce the loan file and servicing record supporting a lender's review, an examiner request, or a portfolio transfer.

sections.heading: Benefits
paragraphs: Organized, retained, access-controlled files make diligence, transfers, and examiner requests a retrieval task rather than a reconstruction project.

faqs.a: Documents are handled within the United States with encrypted transport, and access is limited to authorized personnel on a need-to-know basis.
Records are retained for the period servicing and recordkeeping obligations require, and the retention supports lender reporting and review.

faqs.q: Can you produce a loan file for diligence or transfer?
faqs.a: Yes. On request we can produce the loan file and servicing record to support review or a portfolio transfer.

ctaBody: Request a walkthrough of how loan files are organized, retained, and secured.
